title: Second charge loan of £404k settles business tax debt
summary:
A £404,000 second charge facility has been arranged against a residential property in Hampshire to settle corporate tax liabilities and repay unsecured company debts. Inspired Lending structured the 12-month loan to allow the borrowers to raise capital whilst maintaining their existing first charge mortgage.

title: Santander raises loan-to-income ratio to six times salary
summary:
Santander has increased its loan-to-income ratio to six times salary for first-time buyers earning at least £45,000. The move aligns the lender with competitors including Nationwide, Barclays, NatWest and HSBC, though mortgage brokers caution that higher borrowing limits carry increased repayment risks.

The post Santander raises loan-to-income ratio to six times salary appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Adverse credit accounts for 30% of tenant referencing declines
summary:
Nearly one-third of tenant referencing failures are linked to adverse credit history, according to new data from lettings platform Propoly. The analysis found that approximately 62% of tenants pass referencing checks outright, while 29% receive conditional approval and just 6.4% are declined.

The post Adverse credit accounts for 30% of tenant referencing declines appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: ASA orders property portal and agents to amend adverts
summary:
The Advertising Standards Authority has ruled that OnTheMarket, estate agency Edward Mellor, and two housing providers must amend shared ownership advertisements. The properties were advertised at prices ranging from £49,375 to £107,500 without adequately clarifying these covered only percentage shares rather than full ownership.

The post ASA orders property portal and agents to amend adverts appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Connells Group commits to 1,000 youth work placements
summary:
Connells Group has announced plans to provide 1,000 work experience placements across its estate agency and property services operations as part of the Government's National Mission on Work Experience initiative. The programme, scheduled to begin in March 2027, targets 14 to 16-year-olds and addresses a gap affecting nearly one million young people not in education, employment or training.

The post Connells Group commits to 1,000 youth work placements appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: First-time buyer scheme excludes 70% of England’s districts
summary:
Price caps under the Government's Your First Home scheme will exclude 70% of England's local authority districts, according to new analysis. Average new-build property prices exceed the proposed caps in 207 of 295 local authority areas.

The post First-time buyer scheme excludes 70% of England’s districts appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Rent arrears drive 53% of landlord possession claims
summary:
Rent arrears account for more than half of landlord possession claims, according to new research from the National Residential Landlords Association. A survey found that 53% of landlords who have sought possession cited rent arrears as a key reason.

The post Rent arrears drive 53% of landlord possession claims appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Anthropic IPO expected to create tech wealth for London market
summary:
The anticipated Anthropic IPO, expected to value the AI company at $1.4 trillion, could create more than 4,000 new millionaires among staff. Research firm SaaStr estimates the minimum value generated for employees at the AI lab will be $20 million each, potentially impacting London's high-end property market.

The post Anthropic IPO expected to create tech wealth for London market appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Bridging loan secures North London property in three weeks
summary:
Redwood Bank has completed a £250,000 bridging loan that enabled two property investors to acquire a North London semi-commercial freehold within a three-and-a-half-week timeframe. The property comprises a ground-floor commercial unit and a four-bedroom house in multiple occupation.

The post Bridging loan secures North London property in three weeks appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Regulated bridge loan highlights mortgage exit strategy risks
summary:
StreamBank has completed a £320,000 regulated bridging loan with monitoring conditions attached to track the borrower's progress towards a residential mortgage refinance. The case highlights lender concerns about exit strategy risks in bridge-to-bridge transactions.

The post Regulated bridge loan highlights mortgage exit strategy risks appeared first on PropertyWire.
